item.name: 02 - Validate dispatch UNKNOWN - GET /api/mcc-dispatches/validate/DSP-9999-0001 - Should be 404 not recognised

request.description: Unknown dispatch not recognised 404 DSP-9999-0001 per AC 62/70 - dispatch number not recognised - IMccDispatchClient validation

exec: pm.test('Not recognised message', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.match(/not recognised|not found|unknown|dispatch/i); });

item.name: 03 - Validate dispatch VALID - GET /api/mcc-dispatches/validate/DN-20260916-01 - Should be 200 accepted

request.description: Valid dispatch DN-20260916-01 accepted factory intake per AC 62/70 - IMccDispatchClient returns valid

exec: pm.test('Valid dispatch 200 OK accepted', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: MccDispatches recent - MccDispatchDto reference bowserRegistration dispatchDate totalQuantityLitres dispatchedBy recordedAtUtc per Swagger

item.name: 05 - Get processing runs list - GET /api/processing-runs - FIXED endpoint

request.description: FIXED: Was /api/ProcessingRuns (PascalCase) now /api/processing-runs (kebab-case) per Swagger - returns array of processing runs with dispatchNumber storingTankCode quantityKg temperatureC isTemperatureDeviation state qualityTestStatus hasQualityPanel qualityVerdict createdAtUtc createdBy

exec: pm.test('Processing runs list 200 OK', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Has dispatchNumber storingTankCode quantityKg temperatureC state', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.match(/dispatchNumber|storingTankCode|quantityKg|temperatureC|state/i); });

pm.test('Save first run dispatchNumber', function() { try { const arr = pm.response.json(); if (arr.length > 0) { pm.environment.set('dispatchNumberValid', arr[0].dispatchNumber); pm.environment.set('processingRunId', arr[0].id); } } catch(e) {} });

request.description: Get processing run detail by dispatchNumber - returns id dispatchNumber storingTankId storingTankCode quantityKg temperatureC isTemperatureDeviation state qualityTestStatus holdReason batchCode createdAtUtc updatedAtUtc createdBy hasQualityPanel qualityVerdict

exec: pm.test('Processing run detail 200 OK', function() { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 07 - Record milk unload VALID - POST /api/processing-runs/unload - temp 2.0°C valid

request.description: FIXED: Was POST /api/ProcessingRuns (wrong) now POST /api/processing-runs/unload per Swagger - body dispatchNumber storingTankId quantityKg temperatureC smellOk colourOk tasteOk - temp 1-3°C outline 1.0 false 2.5 false 3.0 false 0.4 true 4.8 true - 2.0°C valid no deviation

exec: pm.test('Save dispatchNumber', function() { try { const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.dispatchNumber) pm.environment.set('dispatchNumberValid', b.dispatchNumber); if (b.id) pm.environment.set('processingRunId', b.id); } catch(e) {} });

item.name: 08 - Record milk unload DEVIATION 5.2°C warns but saves IsDeviation true

request.description: Record milk unload DEVIATION 5.2°C warns but saves IsDeviation true warning outside 1 to 3 per AC 62 - temp 5.2°C outside 1-3 outline should warn but save with isTemperatureDeviation true

exec: pm.test('Unload 5.2°C deviation 200 OK warns but saves', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,201]); });
pm.test('IsTemperatureDeviation true warning outside 1 to 3', function() { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.match(/isTemperatureDeviation|true|deviation|warning|outside/i); });
